Use case: stylized-concept. Create one landscape 16:9 environment illustration for the clickable bunker-floor panel of A-Discord, a grim fictional post-imperial grand strategy game. This is a full interior environment, NOT an icon and NOT a UI screenshot. A believable underground concrete level seen from a slightly elevated wide side-on three-quarter perspective, rich hand-painted realistic game concept art, deep concrete beams, aged olive metal, copper pipes, amber practical lamps, restrained desaturated teal shadows. The whole room and its function must read clearly at small thumbnail size; wide strong silhouettes, crisp material details, no excessive haze, no crushed black shadows. Frame the floor edge and its thick ceiling as a distinct architectural slice, interior fills the entire landscape. Human figures only tiny incidental silhouettes for scale. No text, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no interface, no watermark. Keep visual style consistent with a five-floor shelter: functional machinery, scarcity, rugged engineering, no fantasy elements.
LEVEL ONE - the surface access and shelter intake floor. Massive blast door at the far left, a guarded checkpoint with analogue monitoring console, a short reinforced corridor, a small waiting shelter with benches and stacked emergency kits to the right. Warm amber entry lights contrast with a sliver of cold daylight through the access shaft. The visible architecture tells how people arrive and are protected.
